name: evaluation_id
description: Evaluation run id this profile belongs to; joins to evaluation_data_history.evaluation_id.

name: table_name
description: Table this profile was computed for.

name: column_name
description: Column this profile is scoped to, if column-level.

name: edge
description: FK edge this profile is scoped to, if relationship-level.

name: profile_kind
description: histogram | quantiles | topk | length_hist | shape_mix | char_classes | temporal_mix | null_patterns | corr_matrix | contingency | dcr_hist | nndr_hist | roc_curve | moments

name: n
description: Number of rows/values the profile was computed over.

name: truncated
description: True if the profile payload was truncated (e.g. a top-k cutoff).

name: edges_digest
description: Digest of the bin edges used, so payloads sharing it are directly comparable.
